name: Insugen 30/70 100IU Injection 1X10ml
introduction:
Introduction About INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION Works

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION

Use INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION under careful medical supervision. Inject INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Injection site reactions (such as pain, redness, itching or swelling)
Lipodystrophy (shrinkage of fat tissues beneath the skin)
Lumps under the skin
Weight gain, swelling of body parts
Hypoglycemia (Low blood sugar levels)
Diabetic retinopathy (eye diseases due to diabetes)
Swelling around the ankles and other joints
Painful neuropathy (pain caused by nerve damage)
Problem in vision

Allergic reaction (generalized skin rash with itching, sweating, and swelling of layers under the skin, difficulties in breathing, palpitation, vomiting, stomach upset, reduction in blood pressure and fainting /loss of consciousness)

Signs of severe hypoglycemia (such as cold sweats, cool pale skin, headache, rapid heartbeat, nausea, increased hunger, temporary vision changes, drowsiness, tiredness and weakness, nervousness or tremor, anxiety, confusion and difficulty in concentrating)

warnings.details: INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION can be used during pregnancy if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION is considered safe for use during breastfeeding. However, consult your doctor before administration.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it could aggravate your existing disease condition.
INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
Talk to your doctor before receiving INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION if you are allergic to Regular insulin, Isophane insulin or to any other Human insulin (Ex. Lente, ultra-Lente).
INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should be taken with caution in patients with heart disease. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION can be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before administration. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood glucose levels and kidney functions are required in such patients.

Others

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have or at risk of developing hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels)

Talk to your doctor before receiving INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION if you:

Have problems in adrenal, pituitary or thyroid glands
Have recently changed your diet plan and lifestyle
Are exercising more than usual
Recently became ill or had any infections
Are planning to go abroad (as mealtime and injection timings may get changed)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION is administered, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other antidiabetic agents (Ex. tolbutamide, glibenclamide, glipizide), biguanides (Ex. metformin, phenformin), thiazolidinediones (Ex. pioglitazone), DPP-4 inhibitors (Ex. sitagliptin, vildagliptin) or SGLT-2 inhibitors (Ex. remogliflozin)
Antidepressants (Ex. rasagiline, selegiline, phenelzine)
Heart medicines (Ex. propranolol, atenolol, nebivolol) or ACE inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril)
Salicylates (used to relieve pain or fever) Ex. aspirin
Anabolic steroids (used to build muscle and improve athlete performance) Ex. testosterone, nandrolone, oxandrolone
Sulfonamide antibiotics (Ex. sulfasalazine, sulfadiazine, sulfamethoxazole)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. mifepristone,
Thiazide diuretics (Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Glucocorticoids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. cortisone, betamethasone, beclomethasone, dexamethasone, budesonide, prednisone
Thyroid hormones (used to manage thyroid deficiency) Ex. thyroxine, triiodothyronine
Sympathomimetic agents (used to manage asthma or other circulatory disorders) Ex. ephedrine, adrenaline, salbutamol, or terbutaline
Growth hormone (a hormone used to increase skeletal and somatic growth in the body)
Danazol (a medicine used for endometriosis)
Octreotide (used to manage diarrhea)
Lanreotide (a medicine used to manage abnormal body growth)

B. Interaction with food or drink:

INSUGEN 30/70 100IU INJECTION should be administered 30 minutes before a meal.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else took too much of this medicine, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away as it may cause severe hypoglycemia. Symptoms of hypoglycemia might include fainting, feel unwell, sweating, vomiting, difficulty in breathing, fast heartbeat, and dizziness.

introduction:
Introduction About LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE

LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

How LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

LANTUS 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

HUMINSULIN 30/70 100IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN 30/70 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN 30/70 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

How GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE.

GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION

HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION Works

HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION

Use HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN R 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION

INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION Works

INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:

Use INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSUGEN R 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU

RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU is a combination of Insulin Aspart and Insulin Degludec which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It is used to improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both Type I and Type II).

Diabetes mellitus is a chronic disease characterized by abnormally high levels of glucose in the blood. It is caused either due to inadequate production of a hormone called insulin (produced by pancreas to metabolize glucose) in the body or due to inadequate sensitivity of body cells to the actions of insulin.

RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 years or older). It must be injected beneath the skin (such as on the thigh, upper arm or abdomen). Avoid sharing needles, as it may increase the risk of infections. Along with the management, avoid smoking and alcohol consumption, and diet with regular physical activity as advised by your doctor.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU Works

RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improves sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU

Use RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU under careful medical supervision. Inject RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with RYZODEG FLEX TOUCH PEN 100IU without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About HUMAN MIXTARD 30/70 40IU INJECTION

HUMAN MIXTARD 30/70 40IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II).

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMAN MIXTARD 30/70 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Introduction About INSUGEN 50/50 40IU INJECTION

INSUGEN 50/50 40IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN 50/50 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN 50/50 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION

WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION Works

WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION

Use WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION under careful medical supervision. Inject WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN NEW 30/70 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION

NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION contains Insulin Aspart, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It is used to manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II).

Diabetes mellitus is a chronic disease characterized by abnormally high levels of glucose in the blood. It is caused either by inadequate production of a hormone called insulin (produced by the pancreas to metabolize glucose) in the body or by inadequate sensitivity of body cells to the actions of insulin.

NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION is a fast-acting medicine that begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10–20 minutes after administration, and its effects may last up to 3–4 hours. NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 year or older).

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, have made sudden changes to your diet, or are performing intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of injecting NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin, and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION
To manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION Works

NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION helps your body make use of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose in the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improves sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial or cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to administration, visualize the cartridge or vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use, and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of infection transmission.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before mixing NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION with other insulins. Do not stop therapy with NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and frequency of administration depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

Other medicines used to manage diabetes include sulfonylureas (Ex. tolbutamide, glibenclamide, and glipizide), biguanides (Ex. metformin and phenformin), thiazolidinediones (Ex. pioglitazone), DPP-4 inhibitors (Ex. sitagliptin and vildagliptin), and SGLT-2 inhibitors (Ex. remogliflozin)
Medicines used to manage depression, such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. rasagiline, selegiline, and phenelzine),

Salicylates (used to relieve pain or fever) Ex. aspirin

Sulphonamide antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. sulfasalazine, sulfadiazine, sulfamethoxazole
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills), Ex. mifepristone,
Thiazide diuretics (used to increase urine output and reduce blood pressure) Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Glucocorticoids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. cortisone, betamethasone, beclomethasone, dexamethasone, budesonide, and prednisone
Thyroid hormone (used to manage thyroid disorders) Ex. thyroxine, triiodothyronine

NOVORAPID 100IU INJECTION should be administered at least 10 minutes before a meal.

introduction:
Introduction About LANTUS 100IU INJECTION

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS 100IU INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:

To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How LANTUS 100IU INJECTION Works

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION.

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
LANTUS 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION.
The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS 100IU INJECTION in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS 100IU INJECTION.

Others

LANTUS 100IU INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

name: Novomix 30 Flexpen 1X3ml
introduction:
Introduction About NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN

NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN contains Biphasic Insulin Aspart and Insulin Aspart which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Insulin Aspart is a pre-mixed combination of Insulin Aspart and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10-20 minutes after administration. NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older).

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN Works

Biphasic Insulin Aspart is a combination of Insulin Aspart and NPH. Insulin Aspart is a fast-acting insulin that mimics the natural release of insulin by the pancreas in response to meals. It also helps control the postprandial (after-meal) rise in blood glucose. NPH slows down the absorption and extend the action of insulin. It provides a prolonged and more sustained release of insulin, helping to manage blood sugar levels between meals and overnight. Collectively, they help in controlling both immediate post-meals rise in blood sugar and the basal (background) insulin needs throughout the day.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN

Use NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN under careful medical supervision. Inject NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with NOVOMIX 30 FLEXPEN without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN R NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO)

GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO) contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO), inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO). Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO). The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO) in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARITUS 100IU PEN(DISPO) are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED)

TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) contains Insulin Degludec, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antidiabetics. TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) is used to manage diabetes mellitus (high blood sugar) in adults, adolescents, and children (aged 1 year and above).

TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) is also used in combination with oral or other injectable antidiabetic medicines to manage type 2 diabetes mellitus. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage type 1 diabetes mellitus when used in combination with meal-related rapid-acting insulin medicines in affected individuals.

Before administering TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED), inform your doctor if you have abnormally low or high blood sugar levels, eye disorders, poor eyesight, liver, and/or kidney problems.

TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution during pregnancy and by women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be administered with caution to breastfeeding women.

TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1 to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) are low blood sugar levels (associated with symptoms such as sweating, tiredness, dizziness, and/or feeling increased hunger) and injection site reactions (such as pain, redness, itchy welts, swelling, and/or itching). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED)
To manage diabetes mellitus
mechanismOfAction:
How TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) Works

TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) works by enhancing the body tissues to rapidly uptake glucose from the blood, which results in a controlled blood glucose level, thus managing diabetes mellitus and its associated symptoms in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED)

Administer TRESIBA 100IU FLEX TOUCH PEN(PREFILLED) as advised by your physician. It is given under the skin (subcutaneously) at specific areas such as the front of the thighs, upper arms, or the front of the waist (abdomen). Keep changing the site of injection each day to reduce the risk of developing lumps and skin pitting.

Insert the needle into the skin as per your doctor’s advice. Ensure that you can see the dose counter properly. Gently press and hold down the dose button until the dose counter value returns to zero. Leave the needle under the skin for a minimum of 6 seconds. Pull the pen straight up from the skin. If blood oozes out at the injection site, press gently with a cotton swab. Do not rub the bleeding area.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, stress, physical activity, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION

LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION Works

LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with LUPISULIN R 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

name: Basalog 100IU Injection 1X5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BASALOG 100IU INJECTION

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG 100IU INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN R 100IU INJECTION

HUMINSULIN R 100IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN R 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN R 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

HUMINSULIN R 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION

HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Uses Of HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION Works

HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMAN INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION

HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

usesDetails:
Uses Of HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION Works

HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN N 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults

To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE.
The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE.

Others

GLARITUS 100IU CARTRIDGE is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

introduction:
Introduction About NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE

NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE contains Insulin Aspart, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It is used to manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II).

Diabetes mellitus is a chronic disease characterized by abnormally high levels of glucose in the blood. It is caused either by inadequate production of a hormone called insulin (produced by the pancreas to metabolize glucose) in the body or by inadequate sensitivity of body cells to the actions of insulin.

NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE is a fast-acting medicine that begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10–20 minutes after administration, and its effects may last up to 3–4 hours. NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 year or older).

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, have made sudden changes to your diet, or are performing intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of injecting NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin, and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE
To manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE Works

NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE helps your body make use of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose in the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improves sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial or cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to administration, visualize the cartridge or vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use, and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of infection transmission.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before mixing NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE with other insulins. Do not stop therapy with NOVORAPID PENFILL CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and frequency of administration depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE

NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

To manage diabetes mellitus in adults

How NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

NOBEGLAR 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

Have diabetic ketoacidosis

usageDetails:
How to use INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSULATARD 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION

GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARITUS 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION

LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
