mechanismOfAction:
How LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION Works

LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION

Use LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION under careful medical supervision. Inject LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with LUPISULIN M 30/70 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION

HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION Works

HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Use HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN L 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BASALOG 100IU INJECTION

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG 100IU INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION.

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
BASALOG 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION.
The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG 100IU INJECTION in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

BASALOG 100IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG 100IU INJECTION.

Have diabetic ketoacidosis

name: Novomix 50 Flexpen 1X3ml
introduction:
Introduction About NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN

NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN contains Biphasic Insulin Aspart and Insulin Aspart which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Insulin Aspart is a pre-mixed combination of Insulin Aspart and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10-20 minutes after administration. NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older).

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN Works

Biphasic Insulin Aspart is a combination of Insulin Aspart and NPH. Insulin Aspart is a fast-acting insulin that mimics the natural release of insulin by the pancreas in response to meals. It also helps control the postprandial (after-meal) rise in blood glucose. NPH slows down the absorption and extend the action of insulin. It provides a prolonged and more sustained release of insulin, helping to manage blood sugar levels between meals and overnight. Collectively, they help in controlling both immediate post-meals rise in blood sugar and the basal (background) insulin needs throughout the day.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN

Use NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN under careful medical supervision. Inject NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with NOVOMIX 50 FLEXPEN without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION

XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION Works

XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION

Use XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with XSULIN R 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE

EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin lispro which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults and children for the management of diabetes mellitus.

Diabetes mellitus is a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of the blood sugar, due to which there is high blood sugar levels causing increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, increased ketone levels in urine.

Along with EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE management, your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining weight, quitting alcohol and smoking and exercising regularly.

Before using EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, if you exercise more, are ill or going abroad. Avoid consumption of alcohol while using EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before using EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE for your child depending on their age, body weight, and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE are skin allergy at injection site, pain, swelling, itching, redness, etc. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not reduce over time.

Use EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE as advised by your physician. It should only be injected under the skin (subcutaneous injection). Do not administer EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE into a vein or muscle. The best areas to inject are the front of your waist (abdomen), upper arms, buttocks, or the front of your thighs. EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE can be given at any time during the day, but at the same time each day.

Change the place within the area where you inject it every day to reduce the risk of developing changes under the skin. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using EGLUCENT RAPID 100IU CARTRIDGE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION

HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION Works

HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN N 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN

NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN. The safety and effectiveness of NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN Works

NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving NOBEGLAR UNO 100IU PREFILLED PEN.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION

HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION Works

HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION

Use HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMAN INTERACT 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE

HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin lispro which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults and children for the management of diabetes mellitus.

Diabetes mellitus is a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of the blood sugar, due to which there is high blood sugar levels causing increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, increased ketone levels in urine.

Along with HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE management, your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining weight, quitting alcohol and smoking and exercising regularly.

Before using HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, if you exercise more, are ill or going abroad. Avoid consumption of alcohol while using HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before using HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE for your child depending on their age, body weight, and disease condition.

The most common side effects of using HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE are skin allergy at injection site, pain, swelling, itching, redness, etc. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not reduce over time.

Use HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE as advised by your physician. It should only be injected under the skin (subcutaneous injection). Do not administer HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE into a vein or muscle. HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE can be given at any time during the day, but at the same time each day.

Change the place within the area where you inject it every day to reduce the risk of developing changes under the skin. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using HUMALOG 100IU CARTRIDGE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE

EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Insulin Lispro which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Insulin Lispro is a pre-mixed combination of Insulin Lispro and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10-20 minutes after administration.  

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

usesDetails:
Uses Of EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

Biphasic Insulin lispro is a combination of Insulin lispro and NPH. Insulin lispro is a fast-acting insulin that mimics the natural release of insulin by the pancreas in response to meals. It also helps control the postprandial (after-meal) rise in blood glucose. NPH slows down the absorption and extends the action of insulin. It provides a prolonged and more sustained release of insulin, helping to manage blood sugar levels between meals and overnight. Collectively, they help in controlling both immediate post-meals rise in blood sugar and the basal (background) insulin needs throughout the day.
usageDetails:
How to use EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with EGLUCENT MIX 25 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE

BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASUGINE 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION

INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:

Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION Works

INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:

Use INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSUTREND R 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE

EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Insulin Lispro which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Insulin Lispro is a pre-mixed combination of Insulin Lispro and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10-20 minutes after administration.  

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

Biphasic Insulin lispro is a combination of Insulin lispro and NPH. Insulin lispro is a fast-acting insulin that mimics the natural release of insulin by the pancreas in response to meals. It also helps control the postprandial (after-meal) rise in blood glucose. NPH slows down the absorption and extends the action of insulin. It provides a prolonged and more sustained release of insulin, helping to manage blood sugar levels between meals and overnight. Collectively, they help in controlling both immediate post-meals rise in blood sugar and the basal (background) insulin needs throughout the day.
usageDetails:
How to use EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with EGLUCENT MIX 50 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION

BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

How BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION Works

BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG ONE 100IU PEN INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION

INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION Works

INSUGEN N 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

How to use ACTRAPID HM PENFILL CARTRIDGE

Use ACTRAPID HM PENFILL CARTRIDGE exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

ACTRAPID HM PENFILL CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with ACTRAPID HM PENFILL CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor.

name: Basugine Injection 1X10ml
introduction:
Introduction About BASUGINE INJECTION

BASUGINE INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASUGINE INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of BASUGINE INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASUGINE INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of BASUGINE INJECTION
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How BASUGINE INJECTION Works

BASUGINE INJECTION lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.
usageDetails:
How to use BASUGINE INJECTION

BASUGINE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION, as it is unknown if it will harm the unborn baby. It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

BASUGINE INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving BASUGINE INJECTION, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BASUGINE INJECTION, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

BASUGINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION.

BASUGINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
BASUGINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION.
The safety and effectiveness of BASUGINE INJECTION in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

BASUGINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving BASUGINE INJECTION.

Others

BASUGINE INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

name: Wosulin 30/70 Pen(Dispo) 1X3ml
introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO)

WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO)
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) Works

WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO)

Use WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) under careful medical supervision. Inject WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN 30/70 PEN(DISPO) without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE

WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN NEW 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED)

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED), inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED). Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED). The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED)
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) Works

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED), as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED), as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED).

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED), inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED).
The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED).

Others

LANTUS SOLOSTAR 100IU PEN(PREFILLED) is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

Medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart conditions Ex. metoprolol, atenolol, clonidine, guanethidine, reserpine, chlorothiazide, diazoxide, benazepril, captopril, disopyramide

Danazol (a medicine acting on ovulation)
Niacin used to manage cholesterol levels
Fluoxetine (used to manage depression)
Fibrates (used to lower high levels of blood lipids)

name: Insugen R 100IU Injection 1X10ml
introduction:
Introduction About INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION

INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION Works

INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION

Use INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSUGEN R 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE Works

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.
usageDetails:
How to use BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE, as it is unknown if it will harm the unborn baby. It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE.

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE.
The safety and effectiveness of BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE.

Others

BASALOG REFIL CARTRIDGE is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar
