introduction:
Introduction About MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN

MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN Works

MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN

Use MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN under careful medical supervision. Inject MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with MIXTARD 30 100IU FLEXPEN without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN N NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPISULIN M30

LUPISULIN M30 contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with LUPISULIN M30 if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving LUPISULIN M30 are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

LUPISULIN M30 helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPISULIN M30

Use LUPISULIN M30 under careful medical supervision. Inject LUPISULIN M30 into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

LUPISULIN M30 should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with LUPISULIN M30 without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE

INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE Works

INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE

Use INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSUGEN 50/50 REFIL CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE

GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.

GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARZEN NEW 100IU CARTRIDGE.

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

introduction:
Introduction About XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION

XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:

Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION Works

XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Use XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with XSULIN R 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

name: TOUJEO 300 Cartridge 1.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE

TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE Works

TOUJEO 300 CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE

WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN 50/50 100IU CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION

RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION Works

RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION

Use RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION under careful medical supervision. Inject RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with RECOSULIN M 30/70 100IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RYZODEG PENFILL 100IU CARTRIDGE

Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU is used to improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both Type I and Type II). It contains Insulin Aspart and Insulin Degludec, which belong to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents, which help your body make use of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver.

Diabetes mellitus is a chronic disease characterized by abnormally high levels of glucose in the blood. It is caused either by inadequate production of a hormone called insulin (produced by the pancreas to metabolize glucose) in the body or by inadequate sensitivity of body cells to the actions of insulin.

Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 years or older). It must be injected beneath the skin (such as on the thigh, upper arm, or abdomen). Avoid sharing needles, as it may increase the risk of infection. Along with the management, avoid smoking and alcohol consumption, and diet with regular physical activity as advised by your doctor.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, have made sudden changes to your diet, or have performed intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin, and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

usageDetails:
How to use RYZODEG PENFILL 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use the Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU under careful medical supervision. Inject Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial or cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to administration, visualize the cartridge or vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use, and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of infection transmission.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with Ryzodeg Penfill Cartridge 100 IU without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and frequency of administration depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How ILETIN NPH 40IU INJECTION Works

ILETIN NPH 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use ILETIN NPH 40IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

ILETIN NPH 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with ILETIN NPH 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION. The safety and effectiveness of BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION Works

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.
usageDetails:
How to use BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION.

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.
BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION.
The safety and effectiveness of BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION.

Others

BASAGLAR KWIKPEN INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

introduction:
Introduction About APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE

APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glulisine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in the management of diabetes mellitus in adults, adolescents and children aged 6 years and above.

Diabetes mellitus is a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores and frequent infections.

APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE is not recommended for use if you have hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar). APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney and heart disease, stroke and hypothyroidism. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in pregnant women and breastfeeding women. APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE.

The most common side effects of receiving APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar, skin and allergic reactions at the injection site (such as reddening, unusually intense pain on injection, itching, hives, swelling or inflammation). Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus
usesDetails:
Uses Of APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE
To manage diabetes mellitus
mechanismOfAction:
How APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE Works

APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers blood glucose levels by stimulating skeletal muscle and fat for uptake of glucose and by inhibiting glucose production in liver. Thus, helps to control blood sugar levels effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE

Use APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE as advised by the physician. It should be taken shortly (0-15 minutes) before or soon after meals. It is injected under the skin (subcutaneously) in the abdominal wall, the thigh or the upper arm.

It may also be given into the vein (intravenously) in the abdominal wall by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your lifestyle and the results of your blood sugar (glucose) tests and your previous insulin usage.

Do not stop APIDRA 100IU CARTRIDGE without speaking to a doctor. Otherwise, this could lead to severe hyperglycaemia (very high blood sugar) and ketoacidosis (build-up of acid in the blood because the body is breaking down fat instead of sugar).

introduction:
Introduction About LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION

LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION Works

LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with LUPISULIN N 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

How HUMALOG MIX25 CARTRIDGE Works

Biphasic Insulin lispro is a combination of Insulin lispro and NPH. Insulin lispro is a fast-acting insulin that mimics the natural release of insulin by the pancreas in response to meals. It also helps control the postprandial (after-meal) rise in blood glucose. NPH slows down the absorption and extends the action of insulin. It provides a prolonged and more sustained release of insulin, helping to manage blood sugar levels between meals and overnight. Collectively, they help in controlling both immediate post-meals rise in blood sugar and the basal (background) insulin needs throughout the day.

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION

WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION contains Human Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

Carefully follow the instructions given by the doctor in case of self-administration. Do not mix or change your insulin unless your doctor tells you to do so.

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION
Improves glycaemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION Works

WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageInstructions: Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION

Use WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION exactly as advised by your doctor.

For Injections: Injections (supplied as vials or ampoules) must be administered only a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Your doctor will decide correct dose, frequency of administration and the injection site depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

For Pre-filled syringe or insulin pens:

Inject this medicine exactly as instructed by your doctor. It should be injected beneath the skin (subcutaneously). Carefully follow the instructions provided by your doctor if you are administering it by yourself.

Prior to the administration, rotate the device well for 10 times between your palms and invert 10 times, until the liquid forms a uniform mixture
Do not shake the medicine vigorously, as it may form a froth
Insert a fresh needle before injection. Make sure that the medicine does not contain any lumps or air bubbles in it
After injecting the medicine, remove the needle from the pen and dispose it immediately
Do not share your needle or disposable pens or pre-filled syringe with anyone to avoid the risk of spreading infections
Dispose the pen or pre-filled syringe, once it is empty
Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, the injection site should be rotated. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN R NEW 40IU INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN

INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN Works

INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with INSULATARD 100IU FLEXPEN without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FIASP 100IU PENFILL

FIASP 100IU PENFILL contains Insulin Aspart, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It is used to manage diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II).

Diabetes mellitus is a chronic disease characterized by abnormally high levels of glucose in the blood. It is caused either by inadequate production of a hormone called insulin (produced by the pancreas to metabolize glucose) in the body or by inadequate sensitivity of body cells to the actions of insulin.

FIASP 100IU PENFILL is a fast-acting medicine that begins to lower blood sugar levels within 10–20 minutes after administration, and its effects may last up to 3–4 hours. FIASP 100IU PENFILL is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 year or older).

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with FIASP 100IU PENFILL if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, have made sudden changes to your diet, or are performing intense exercise as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of injecting FIASP 100IU PENFILL are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin, and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How FIASP 100IU PENFILL Works

FIASP 100IU PENFILL helps your body make use of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose in the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improves sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use FIASP 100IU PENFILL

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial or cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to administration, visualize the cartridge or vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use, and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of infection transmission.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before mixing FIASP 100IU PENFILL with other insulins. Do not stop therapy with FIASP 100IU PENFILL without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and frequency of administration depending on your age, body weight, and health condition.

Before receiving FIASP 100IU PENFILL, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Other medicines used to manage diabetes include sulfonylureas (Ex. tolbutamide, glibenclamide, and glipizide), biguanides (Ex. metformin and phenformin), thiazolidinediones (Ex. pioglitazone), DPP-4 inhibitors (Ex. sitagliptin and vildagliptin), and SGLT-2 inhibitors (Ex. remogliflozin)
Medicines used to manage depression, such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. rasagiline, selegiline, and phenelzine),

Sulphonamide antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. sulfasalazine, sulfadiazine, sulfamethoxazole

introduction:
Introduction About LEVEMIR FLEXPEN

LEVEMIR FLEXPEN contains Insulin Detemir which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic drugs. It is used in the management of hyperglycaemia in adults, adolescents and children aged 1 year and above.

LEVEMIR FLEXPEN is not recommended for use if you have low blood sugar and diabetes ketoacidosis (a complication of diabetes). LEVEMIR FLEXPEN should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

LEVEMIR FLEXPEN can be used during pregnancy if clinically needed. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using LEVEMIR FLEXPEN are low blood sugar (cold sweat, pale skin, headache, rapid heartbeat, nausea, drowsiness), injection site reactions, itching, rash, weight gain, swollen hands and feet, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms deteriorate.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally inject too much of LEVEMIR FLEXPEN, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of LEVEMIR FLEXPEN overdose are low blood levels of sugar and potassium.

Signs include cold sweat, cool pale skin, headache, rapid heartbeat, nausea, feeling very hungry, temporary changes in vision, drowsiness, unusual tiredness and weakness, nervousness or tremor, feeling anxious, feeling confused, difficulty in concentrating. Severe low blood sugar can lead to unconsciousness and can cause brain damage (temporary or permanent) and even death if unmanageed.

introduction:
Introduction About XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE

XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE contains Biphasic Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Biphasic Isophane Insulin is a pre-mixed combination of Regular (soluble) insulin and Isophane (NPH) insulin. It is a fast-acting medicine where it begins to lower blood sugar levels within 30 minutes. Therefore, inject the medicine 30 minutes before meal and make sure to have your meals within the next 30 minutes.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any hormonal problems, made sudden changes to your diet or perform intense exercise as a precaution. Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE Works

XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE

Use XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE under careful medical supervision. Inject XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 10 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 20 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with XSULIN 30/70 CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Lumps under the skin

Hypoglycemia (Low blood sugar levels)

Painful neuropathy (pain caused by nerve damage)
Problem in vision

Signs of severe hypoglycemia (such as cold sweats, cool pale skin, headache, rapid heartbeat, nausea, increased hunger, temporary vision changes, drowsiness, tiredness and weakness, nervousness or tremor, anxiety, confusion and difficulty in concentrating)

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN

HUMINSULIN contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HUMINSULIN
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMINSULIN Works

HUMINSULIN helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMINSULIN

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE

HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:

Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE Works

HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with HUMINSULIN N CARTRIDGE without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN. The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.
uses: To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN
To manage diabetes mellitus in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN Works

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

How to use GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse under the skin (subcutaneously, usually thighs, upper arm, or abdomen). Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

It will be given only if the benefits outweigh the risk to the fetus and mother.

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it is excreted in breast milk. Inform your doctor before receiving this, and the dose will be adjusted by your doctor.

Do not drive or use machines while receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN, as your blood sugar can be low or high and your concentration and ability to react might be affected. Consult your doctor if you have frequent episodes of hypoglycemia.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN, as it can raise or lower your blood sugar levels.

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN.

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Your dose will be adjusted depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN, inform your doctor if you are allergic to insulin, glargine, or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in patients with heart failure, stroke, or other heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN.
The safety and effectiveness of GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN.

Others

GLARITUS DISPOPEN 2 100IU PREFILLED PEN is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetic ketoacidosis
Had an episode of low blood sugar

introduction:
Introduction About WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO)

WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) contains Isophane Insulin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetic agents. It improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II). It helps your body to make utilize of the circulating blood glucose by transporting the circulating glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues.

Talk to your doctor before starting therapy with WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a history of stroke, any infection in the recent days, perform intense exercise or planning to go abroad (as the mealtime and injection timings may vary) as a precaution.

Do not use this medicine if you have hypoglycemia (low blood sugar levels). Consult your doctor before using this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Along with the management, carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor regarding the mealtime and exercise (such as how often and how much to do).

The most common side effects of receiving WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) are low blood sugar levels, pain, redness, itching, swelling or thickening at the injection site, lump formation under the skin and swelling of body parts. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
usesDetails:
Uses Of WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO)
Improves glycemic control in patients with diabetes mellitus (both type I and type II)
mechanismOfAction:
How WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) Works

WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) helps your body to make utilise of the circulating blood glucose. It helps in the transport of glucose from the blood into the muscles and fat tissues. It also stops the production of glucose by the liver. As a result, it controls blood sugar levels and improve sugar control in patients with diabetes mellitus.
usageDetails:
How to use WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO)

Always inject this medicine into your thighs, buttocks, upper arm, or abdomen (i.e., subcutaneously). Do not administer this medicine into the vein or muscle directly. It should be administered at least 30 minutes before meals. Eat a meal or snack containing carbohydrates within 30 minutes of the injection to avoid low blood sugar.

Before administration, roll the vial/cartridge between your hands until the liquid becomes uniformly white and cloudy. While injecting, keep the needle under the skin for at least 6 seconds to make sure that the entire dose is injected.

Prior to the administration, visualize the cartridge/vial for any visible particulate matter and discoloration. Discard the needle and syringe after use and do not share your needles with others to avoid the risk of transmission of infections.

Avoid repeatedly injecting the medicine at the same site to manage skin damage. Instead, rotate the injection site. Make sure to consult your doctor before changing the injection site as a precaution.

WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) should not be mixed with any other insulins before use. Do not stop therapy with WOSULIN N PEN(DISPO) without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide correct dose and frequency of administration depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE

XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE contains Insulin glargine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidiabetics. It is used in adults to manage diabetes mellitus, a disease where the body does not produce enough insulin to control the level of blood sugar, resulting in high blood sugar levels. Symptoms include increased thirst, frequent urination, extreme hunger, unexplained weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, slow-healing sores, frequent infections, and increased ketone levels in urine.

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes, like eating a healthy diet, not skipping meals, maintaining your weight, quitting alcohol and smoking, and exercising regularly. Before management, your doctor might want to take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE, inform your doctor if you have low blood sugar, kidney, liver, or heart problems, or diabetic ketoacidosis. Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before receiving XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE. The safety and effectiveness of XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE in children have yet to be determined.

The most common side effects of receiving XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE are low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), weight gain, and allergic reactions, including reactions at the injection site. If your symptoms do not improve, see your doctor.

To manage diabetes mellitus in adults

XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE lowers the blood glucose, facilitated by increased protein synthesis and uptake of glucose, following the binding of insulin to receptors on muscle and fat cells and then inhibiting glucose output from the liver.

XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE should be used with caution in patients over 65 years of age. The dose will be adjusted, and regular blood and kidney tests will be conducted. Consult your doctor before receiving XGLAR REFIL 100IU CARTRIDGE.
